summary: Fix race condition in next_id() by adding file-based locking
approach: Added filelock dependency and wrapped the load-compute_id-save sequence in TodoApp.add() with a file-based lock to prevent concurrent processes from generating duplicate IDs.

changes.change: Added _lock_path attribute and _get_lock() method to TodoStorage class
Wrapped add() method's load-compute_id-save sequence with file lock

risks: File-based locking adds slight overhead to add() operations
Lock files (.lock) are created alongside the database file
limitations: Only add() operation is protected; other operations (mark_done, remove) could still have race conditions but are less critical
